headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: July 15, 2026**
article:
The American League All-Stars dominated the National League All-Stars, securing a 4-0 victory in the latest MLB action. Miguel Vargas led the offense with a home run and 1 RBI. Meanwhile, several teams made significant roster moves, including the Milwaukee Brewers, who acquired right-handed pitcher Colton Gordon from the Houston Astros.

Injuries continue to plague several teams, with Rob Zastryzny being placed on the 60-day injured list by the Milwaukee Brewers due to a left trapezius strain. Other notable injuries include Drew Millas, who was placed on the 10-day injured list by the Washington Nationals with a left index finger fracture, and Zac Gallen, who was placed on the 15-day injured list by the Arizona Diamondbacks with right elbow inflammation.

The Brewers also made a trade with the Houston Astros, acquiring Colton Gordon in exchange for outfielder Jadyn Fielder and other considerations. Additionally, the Boston Red Sox acquired outfielder Jahmai Jones from the Detroit Tigers in a trade.
